# @game-studio/exceptions

Repo for the exception-handler package.

## Usage

Throwing an exception is fairly straightforward:

```
import { Exception } from '@game-studio';

throw new Exception('name', 'message');
```

This package provides a `console` logger for _free_:

```
import { ConsoleLogger, ExceptionHandler } from '@game-studio';

const exceptionHandler = new ExceptionHandler(new ConsoleLogger());

// in some other file, perhaps, capture errors
exceptionHandler.captureErrors(window);
```
